optimizedContext.value:
# DraftedChangeReadOnlyError

## Rules
- Export `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError extends DomainError`.
- Throw when: `save`/`saveArtifact` on `isDrafted`; `mutate` resolves drafted; entity mutator while drafted (if guards on).
- MUST NOT throw for correctly scoped `mutateDraft`, `RestoreChange`, `DiscardChange`.
- Payload: `changeName`, `operation` (e.g. mutate/save/saveArtifact/transition). Message: drafted+read-only until restored; use draft/drafted terms.
- Stable `code` e.g. `DRAFTED_CHANGE_READ_ONLY`.

## Constraints
- Prefer active-only get/mutate prevention; this error exceptional. CLI presentation per error-handling-conventions.
